about: Edit breakdowns of popular drawing Shorts, in our own words (no footage, titles or audio are reused). Source: the owner's Gemini-app analysis, 2026-11-09. Used to shape styles now, and as context for Gemini-planned edits later.

patterns.rule: The pen is already on the paper making marks in the very first second. No intro, no branding, no blank page.
The finished piece stays unseen or incomplete until the last seconds, so viewers watch to the end (and the loop).
One static top-down view for the whole video; most use no cuts or zooms at all.
A long session compressed into 11-16 s (some up to ~40 s); continuous speed-up reads as satisfying, not choppy.
No text, or one short title anchored at the top for the whole video.
Going straight to ink with no pencil or erasing shows skill and is a hook in itself.
Filming idea: start from a crude stick figure and ink a detailed character over it (curiosity gap). Needs to be drawn that way; the editor can't fake it.
Filming/caption idea: show a real viewer comment requesting the character at the top. Only ever use genuine comments.

references.speed: real time to slightly sped up
references.text: one-word captions mirroring the voice-over, then section titles
references.why: actionable teaching, fast cuts hold attention

references.why: hypnotic mastery, no pencil, no erasing
